approved_by: requester (project owner), explicit instruction in session
purpose: Evaluate QVoice as an annual lagged feature block in model B without claiming an actual publication date.
rule: A QVoice wave from calendar year Y is assigned only to monthly prediction snapshots in calendar year Y+1.
replacement_rule: The next annual wave replaces the prior wave for everyone, including people without a linked response.
employment_episode_rule: A response is usable only while the employment episode remains continuous from the survey anchor to the model snapshot.
interpretation: This is a business modeling assumption for temporal assignment. It does not certify when QVoice results were actually published or available operationally.
privacy: Employee level rows and individual predictions remain in memory only; published artifacts are aggregate and presentation classified.
